name: Auroom Terra Outdoor Cabin Sauna
description: Terra Outdoor Cabin Sauna The Terra is a universally-styled, spacious outdoor sauna model that will be the escape you need, right at home. This sauna is available in a thermo-pine exterior and has the option of left and right-handed door hinges when purchasing. Additionally, the Terra comes in a small or medium size to best fit your needs. This beautiful sauna is delivered fully assembled and ready to use. The Sauna heater is sold separately. Lead times may vary. The unit is sold and shipped fully assembled. Fully Assembled Luxury for Your Backyard The Auroom Terra Outdoor Cabin Sauna is the ultimate in luxury outdoor saunas. This fully assembled sauna provides a lavish wellness space right in your backyard, offering style, comfort, and convenience without the hassle of assembly. Available in two sizes, you can choose the option that best fits your needs, whether it's a compact sauna space or a larger suite with a separate changing and relaxation area. Size Options for Every Need Terra S: The smaller of the two options, this model offers a comfortable sauna space with all the essentials for a perfect sauna session. Terra M: For those who desire more space, the Terra M features a changing and relaxation area in addition to the sauna, providing a comprehensive wellness experience. Features and Benefits Fully Assembled: Ready to use right out of the box, with no assembly required. Universal and Spacious Design: Offers ample space for relaxation and comfort. Rehpol Wooden Framed Window and Door: Black-framed for a cohesive look, available in both left and right-handed options. Ready to Use: Immediate usability upon delivery allows you to enjoy your sauna experience without delay. The Perfect Blend of Functionality and Style The Auroom Terra Outdoor Cabin Sauna in Black offers an exquisite blend of style and functionality. The sleek black exterior combined with the luxurious interior options ensures a sauna that is not only visually stunning but also highly practical. Its universal and spacious design, along with the inclusion of a changing and relaxation area in the Terra M model, makes it a versatile choice for any backyard. Includes Sauna Cabin Benches Backrest Bench supports Bench skirts Floor grids LED strips on the backrest Accessories Bucket Ladle Thermometer Hygrometer Sand Timer Aroma Set Sauna Hat Sauna Pillow Features Fully assembled Universal and spacious design Sleek black/natural exterior Rehpol wooden framed window and door in black Left and right-handed options Ready to use - no assembly required Enhanced sauna experience with included premium accessories Bucket + Ladle Thermometer + Hygrometer Sand Timer Aroma Set Sauna Hat Sauna Pillow Multiple cabin sizes are available to best fit your needs (87 x 102) Actual Dimensions: 86.6"D x 101.6"W x 98.4"H (87 x 150) Actual Dimensions: 86.6"D x 150.8"W x 98.4"H Black Wood Type (Interior) Natural Wood Type (Interior) Natural Wood Type (Exterior) Specifications Model Aura Interior Finish Thermo-aspen Exterior Finish Black Thermo-Spruce / Thermo-Pine Exterior Panels Included Floor Type Duckboard Lighting Type LED Strip Interior Width 58" (147cm) Interior Depth 58" (147cm) Interior Height 79" (198cm) Exterior Width 69" (1750mm) Exterior Depth 68" (1715mm) Exterior Height 97" (2460mm) Weight 3000 lbs (1360kg) Glass Door Thermory Premium Glass Finish Clear Style 8mm Tempered Width 2" (42mm) Assembly & Maintenance Floor Plan Terra S Floor Plan Terra M Warranty The warranty on a sauna or sauna product manufactured by Auroom covers defects caused by the manufacturer for a period of 2 years from the date of delivery to the customer. The warranty does not apply if the customer has not notified the seller or the manufacturer of the defect within 30 days of discovering it, or if the defect is not caused by the manufacturer. For more, please refer to the Auroom Warranty Shipping & Returns This Auroom sauna has a $1,990 flat shipping fee. As an authorized Auroom retailer, we are required to charge this shipping fee. Terra Sauna Cabins are crated and palletized for transportation by truck. Upon delivery, the buyer is responsible for offloading by an onsite forklift or crane. The size of this product requires flat-bed truck delivery by special appointment. This product will require off-loading from the flat-bed truck by a crane or extended forklift. The customer is responsible for arranging the offloading and transporting the product to its final location. A contact number is required by the freight company to facilitate the delivery appointment. To ensure your success, we will call you to share shipment details prior to shipping. Cancellations & Refunds Nordica Sauna prides itself on having one of the best return policies in the industry. Cancel any time before your order has shipped, completely free of charge (exceptions apply, including custom made orders). Call 1-877-587-5387 or email customercare@nordicasauna.com When will I know my order has shipped? As soon as you place your order, you will receive an order confirmation e-mail. This means that we have received your order in our system and pre-authorized your credit card for the purchase. As soon as we receive your order, we automatically reach out to our suppliers to confirm that it is in stock and available for immediate shipment. If your item is on backorder or unavailable, we will void the pre-authorization and reach out to you via e-mail. If your item(s) are available for immediate shipment (within 5 business days), we will process the charges and submit the order for shipment. When will my order ship? If your order is in stock and we process the charges to your credit card, it will ship within five business days from the date of your order. We will send you tracking information within 24 hours of your order leaving the warehouse to the e-mail address you provided when checking out. If you do not receive tracking information from us within six business days of your order, feel free to follow up with us at customercare@nordicasauna.com . No shipping outside the lower 48 States in the USA. What if my shipment is damaged? Please inspect the packaging of your item(s) when they arrive. If you notice any damage, you should make note of it when signing for delivery. If your item(s) do arrive damaged please send photos to customercare@nordicasauna.com and we will process an insurance claim on your behalf. Cancellations (Before order ships) Nordica Sauna prides itself on having one of the best return policies in the industry. Cancel any time before your order has shipped, completely free of charge (exceptions apply, including custom made orders). Reach agents during business hours at 1-877-587-5387, the chat on our website, or email customercare@nordicasauna.com Cancellations of customer orders Custom or made to order products cannot be canceled or refunded as these products are put into production specifically for your order. These units are custom made to your specification or created once you order. Once you place your order they start building your unit. Your warranty will guarantee you a fully functional and operational product. If it is not clear whether your order is custom or made to order, please message or call us. All sales are final for Custom made and Made-to-order products. Refunds & Returns If you need to exchange your product, you may do so. You, as the customer, are responsible for any shipping costs throughout any returns or exchange processes. Not all orders are available for return once they have shipped. We order products directly from the manufacturer. Therefore, if the manufacturer will not permit us to return a product, we cannot offer you a return. This often varies on a case-by-case basis; please reach out to us if you would like specific information on your brand and/or product. Due to drastically increasing LTL/freight shipping costs, any outright returns will incur a 25% cancellation fee + return shipping costs. If you are replacing the product with something else, we may be able to help you cover some of the costs depending on the product. Seller reserves the right to refuse to refund any deposit or payment, or cancel any payment due, and any owing until such time as Seller a) is in receipt of the goods b) has inspected the goods and c) in the Sellers discretion, has found the goods to be free of damage. All refunds will be provided within 5 business days once the product has been returned to the warehouse and inspected for damage. Shipping Times We promise to do our best to get your order to you as soon as possible. We provide estimated shipping times on the product pages based upon what our suppliers and freight companies tell us, and those estimated shipping times may change or vary without notice (Due to supply chain issues, the steel mills behind on making metal, the manufacturers delayed because of the mills, the overwhelmingly demand on shipping, factory/warehouse and dock workers and so on).
